enabled.description: Enable or disable the PoWA collector daemon. Set to `false` to prevent the service from starting.

listen_address.description: IP address the collector listens on for incoming connections (e.g., '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces).

listen_port.description: Port the collector listens on for incoming snapshot submissions.

storage_dir.description: Directory where collected snapshots are stored on disk. Ensure the process has write permissions.

worker_count.description: Number of worker threads/processes to handle incoming snapshots and processing.

max_snapshots.description: Maximum number of snapshots to retain per target. Set to 0 for no limit. Old snapshots are pruned oldest-first.

targets.description: List of PostgreSQL target servers to snapshot remotely. Each target defines how and when to connect and collect snapshots.

conninfo.description: libpq-style connection string (e.g., 'host=db.example.com port=5432 dbname=app user=powa sslmode=require'). Must include credentials if required.

snapshot_every.description: Interval (in seconds) between automatic snapshots for this target.

retention_days.description: Number of days to retain snapshots for this target. Overrides global `max_snapshots` if set > 0.

enabled.description: Enable snapshot collection for this specific target.

tls.enabled.description: Enable TLS (HTTPS) for secure communication to the collector (e.g., when accepting remote snapshot uploads).

tls.cert_file.description: Path to the TLS certificate file (PEM format). Required if TLS is enabled.

tls.key_file.description: Path to the TLS private key file (PEM format). Required if TLS is enabled.

tls.ca_file.description: Optional path to the CA certificate file for client certificate verification (PEM format).

log_level.description: Verbosity of logging: 'debug', 'info', 'warn', 'error', or 'fatal'. Use 'debug' for troubleshooting.
